title: The Burnt Protocol
author: Isandro Nystrom
blurb: Casper Halloran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
